description_en: Retrieves the node details of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 获取AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的节点详情
name: DescribeDBInstanceDiagnosisSummary

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including the instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值说明：

30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0 and cannot exceed the maximum value of the Integer type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The running status of the node. Valid values:

UP: The node is running.
DOWN: The node has failed.

If you do not specify this parameter, information about nodes in all running statuses is returned
parameters.help_zh:
节点运行状态，取值如下：

UP：节点运行中。
DOWN：节点故障。

如果不填，则返回所有运行状态的信息
parameters.name: start_status

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization status of the node. Valid values:

synced: The node is synchronized.
notSyncing: The node is not synchronized.

If you do not specify this parameter, information about nodes in all synchronization statuses is returned
parameters.help_zh:
节点同步状态，取值如下：

synced：已同步。
notSyncing：未同步。

如果不填，则返回所有同步状态的信息
parameters.name: sync_mode

parameters.help_en:
The role status of the node, which indicates whether a primary/secondary switchover has occurred. Valid values:

normal: The role status is normal, indicating that no primary/secondary switchover has occurred.
reverse: The role is reversed, indicating that a primary/secondary switchover has occurred
parameters.help_zh:
节点的角色状态，即是否发生主备切换，取值如下：

normal：角色状态正常，即未发生主备切换。
reverse：角色反转，即发生了主备切换
parameters.name: role_preferd

Items.description_en: The list of node details for the instance

NodeAddress.description_en: The IP address of the node

NodeName.description_en: The name of the host where the node resides

NodePort.description_en: The port number of the node

NodePreferredRole.description_en:
The original role of the node. Valid values:

primary: The primary node.
mirror: The mirror node.

If the value of this parameter is the same as the value of the NodeRole parameter, no role reversal (primary/secondary switchover) has occurred. If the values are different, a role reversal has occurred
NodePreferredRole.description_zh:
节点最初所属角色，取值如下：

primary：主节点。
mirror：副本节点。

如果该参数值与NodeRole参数的值一致，表示没有发生过角色反转（主备切换）；如果该参数值与NodeRole参数的值不一致，表示发生过角色反转

NodeReplicationMode.description_en:
The data synchronization status of the node. Valid values:

Synced: The data is synchronized.
Not Syncing: The data is not synchronized.
No sync required: No synchronization is required. This mode applies only to coordinator nodes
NodeReplicationMode.description_zh:
节点数据同步状态，取值如下：

Synced：已同步。
Not Syncing：未同步。
No sync required：无需同步，仅协调节点会出现该模式

NodeRole.description_en:
The current role of the node. Valid values:

primary: The primary node.
mirror: The mirror node
NodeRole.description_zh:
节点当前所属角色，取值如下：

primary：主节点。
mirror：副本节点

NodeStatus.description_en:
The running status of the node. Valid values:

UP: The node is running.
DOWN: The node has failed
NodeStatus.description_zh:
节点运行状态，取值如下：

UP：节点运行中。
DOWN：节点故障

NodeType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:

master: The coordinator node.
slave: The secondary coordinator node.
segment: The compute node
NodeType.description_zh:
节点类型，取值如下：

master：协调节点。
slave：备协调节点。
segment：计算节点

MasterStatusInfo.description_en: The statistics information about the status of coordinator nodes
MasterStatusInfo.description_zh: 协调节点状态统计信息

ExceptionNodeNum.description_en: The number of nodes in the abnormal state

NormalNodeNum.description_en: The number of nodes in the normal state

NotPreferredNodeNum.description_en: The number of nodes whose roles have been switched due to a primary/secondary switchover
NotPreferredNodeNum.description_zh: 主从切换角色节点数量

PreferredNodeNum.description_en: The number of nodes with normal roles

SegmentStatusInfo.description_en: The statistics information about the status of compute nodes
SegmentStatusInfo.description_zh: 计算节点状态统计信息

ExceptionNodeNum.description_en: The number of nodes in the abnormal state

NormalNodeNum.description_en: The number of nodes in the normal state

NotPreferredNodeNum.description_en: The number of nodes whose roles have been switched due to a primary/secondary switchover
NotPreferredNodeNum.description_zh: 主从切换角色节点数量

PreferredNodeNum.description_en: The number of nodes with normal roles
